title: Claude Code Stop / SubagentStop hook output
description: JSON a Stop or SubagentStop hook prints on stdout (exit 0). Can keep Claude (or a subagent) working instead of stopping. Claude Code force-ends the turn after 8 consecutive blocks. SubagentStop uses this same shape but does not support additionalContext.

decision.description: Optional. Prevents Claude stopping; the turn continues. Omit to allow the stop.

reason.description: Required when 'decision' is block. Tells Claude why to keep going and what to do next.

continue.description: If false, Claude stops processing entirely after the hook runs. Overrides 'decision'.

stopReason.description: Message shown to the user when 'continue' is false. Not shown to Claude.

suppressOutput.description: If true, hides the hook's stdout from the transcript.

systemMessage.description: Warning message shown to the user.

terminalSequence.description: Terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook (OSC 0/1/2/9/99/777 and BEL only; anything else is ignored). Requires Claude Code v2.1.141+.
